correctness.rationale: For smooth char2 cubic X with nonzero squarefree tensor and canonical point p not on X, alternating Hessian has ker span{x,p}; the polar derivative in direction p is a square L^2 and p off X makes L transverse. Coordinates reduce F to C(x0,x1,x2)+u^2M+u^3, with C smooth ordinary ternary cubic. Tangent linear algebra gives differential rank 2 off R=X intersect {u=0}, rank 0 on R. In local smooth coordinates every differential entry is divisible by u^2 and its divided two columns are independent on R, forcing maximal-minor ideal exactly I_R^4, degree 12. Inspected verify.py: one smooth sample over F2/F4/F8 and a symbolic local minor u^4/t^3; additionally independently checked this local minor algebraically. These finite tests do not establish the global scheme identity; proof rests on local division and transversality.
residual_risks: Local rank-two assertion after dividing by u² is the critical geometric step; stated only under p not on X.
The full dual-surface scheme and Gauss morphism degree are outside scope.
